messages:
erin: Follow-up on Dedicated pool autoscale surface. Proposal: tiny intent API (CreatePrewarm + Cancel) + operator shim. Goal: avoid tight control-plane/operator loops.

sam: Make CreatePrewarm idempotent, return intent_id and status. Include idempotency_key.

mike: Avoid stampede: per-tenant soft headroom + global reservoir. Reject if both exhausted.

anika: Token-style budgets for tenants + reservoir tokens for bursts. Decouple from metering.

erin: Fallbacks: fallback_model and fallback_slots if operator can't scale in time. Also define LeaseTimeout event.

ops-bot: deploy: autoscaler v1.12 -> v1.13 in canary-us-west (log: /deploy/2820000000).

sam: Observability: intent_created/accepted/rejected/fulfilled/timed_out with tags region/org/tenant. p95 admission latency.

mike: Operator emits LeaseAccepted/Rejected/Ready/Expired. Shim translates legacy calls during rollout.

anika: I'll draft OpenAPI + migration plan with dual-write, canary shim, metrics checks, rollback.

erin: Proto sketch: PrewarmRequest(tenant_id, slots, expires_at, priority, fallback_model, fallback_slots, idempotency_key) -> PrewarmResponse(intent_id, status, reason).

sam: Make reservoir configurable by org/region and tied to billing limits.

mike: Add jittered backoff for retries on quota rejection to avoid thundering herd. Chaos tests for operator outages.

anika: typo: meant anika :)

erin: noted :) consensus on soft headroom + shared reservoir + idempotent intents. I'll update the RFC and post the doc.
